sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Pizza Craft Game lies its core gameplay mechanics, which are deceptively simple yet incredibly addictive. The game's controls are intuitive and easy to use, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. Simply tap to select ingredients, and the game will guide you through the process. But don't be fooled - the game's AI is clever, and it will throw curveballs at you to keep you on your toes. One wrong move, and you'll lose precious time, and before you know it, the timer will expire, and you'll be left with a sad, incomplete pizza.

As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new ingredients, toppings, and sauces, each with its unique abilities and characteristics.
